title: Lavender and rose drawer sachets
subtitle: Fabric sachets filled with dried lavender buds and dried rose petals
excerpt: Small fabric sachets filled with a blend of dried lavender buds and dried rose petals, scented further with a few drops of lavender essential oil. Tucked into drawers, wardrobes, and linen cupboards to scent stored fabric and deter moths. Makes six sachets. Sachets last 6-12 months, then refill or recharge with essential oil.
sourceNotes: Lavender as moth deterrent: lavandula EO compounds (linalool, camphor) are repellent to Tineola bisselliella (common clothes moth) larvae. The deterrent effect is concentration-dependent and fades as the EO evaporates, sachets need refreshing or replacing every 6-12 months. Rose petals: fragrance co-ingredient; phenylethyl alcohol and geraniol are main volatiles in dried roses. Both deteriorate on drying but some remains. Sachet construction: small muslin or organza bags (10 x 10 cm) filled with approx. 30 g of dried botanical mix per sachet.

recipe.batchNotes: Doubles easily. Make a large batch at lavender harvest time (July in the UK) when fresh lavender is available to dry.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready immediately. The fragrance develops and blends over the first week as the essential oil absorbs into the dried botanicals.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 6-12 months. Recharge by adding 3-4 drops of lavender EO directly into the sachet through the fabric. Replace the botanical fill when the scent no longer refreshes after recharging.

glossaryTerms.definition: Lavender essential oil compounds (linalool, camphor) repel the larvae of Tineola bisselliella, the common clothes moth, which feeds on protein fibres (wool, cashmere, silk). The effect fades as the EO evaporates, sachets need refreshing every 6 months to remain effective.

for wool and cashmere. The sachets last 6-12 months; recharge with a few drops of lavender essential oil directly through the bag to extend the moth-deterrent effect. Makes six sachets.

items.prepNote: dried lavender buds; primary scent and insect deterrent
dried rose petals; adds floral depth to the scent blend
approx. 40 drops; refreshes the scent after a few weeks

content.text: Mix the dried lavender and rose petals in a bowl. Add the lavender essential oil and toss to distribute.
Fill each muslin bag with approximately 30 g of the botanical mix. Draw the string closed.
Place one sachet per drawer, or hang from a wardrobe rail alongside woollen garments.
When the scent fades, add 3-4 drops of lavender essential oil through the fabric. Replace the botanical fill after 12 months.
